title: sftp fs-op JSON
description: Structured success payload for `ssh-cli sftp mkdir|rmdir|rm|rename|stat --json`.

to.description: Only with `rename`: the new remote path

duration_ms.description: Wall time of the operation in milliseconds; always 0 for `stat`, which does not time itself

kind.description: Only with `stat`: the remote file type

size.description: Only with `stat`: size in bytes, omitted when the server sent none

mode.description: Only with `stat`: permission and type bits as the server sent them, omitted when absent

mtime.description: Only with `stat`: modification time in Unix seconds, omitted when absent
